title: ProviderResponse
description: Envelope the Python AI service returns to Go for one job attempt (R-10: provider metadata must never be lost between adapter and persistence; TECH_SPEC §8.3). The Python service returns this over HTTP to the Go worker; it never writes business tables itself. A malformed or failed response must produce an explicit failure state — never a fabricated PASS (TECH_SPEC §28 safe-failure).

known.description: false when the provider does not report cost. Unknown cost is recorded as known=false, never as 0 — zero would fabricate a real measurement (B08 verify).

attempt_token.description: Issued per job lease. A late response whose attempt_token no longer matches the lease is discarded (cancel/expiry safety, R-11).

provider.description: Provider adapter id, e.g. doubao, qwen-vl, fake (offline tests).

model_version.description: null when the provider does not expose a version identifier — recorded as unknown, never guessed.

prompt_version.description: e.g. assessment/v1 — must match a versioned prompt file (ADR-0001 layout).

input_hash.description: sha256 over the canonicalized model input (prompt + evidence references + rules). Enables reproducibility checks without storing raw material in logs.

assessments.description: Candidate assessments, one per assessed rule. May be empty (no rule assessable) — an empty array is a valid, persistable result and NOT a failure.

attempts.description: All provider calls spent for this outcome, including repairs and fallbacks — the shared request budget (execution plan §6) is accounted from this list.

retryable.description: Go decides retry from this flag plus its own lease/budget state; auth and quota errors are never retryable (stop immediately per execution plan §6).

message.description: Diagnostic for the job failure record. Must not contain raw evidence content or credentials (TECH_SPEC §15.3).

kind.description: initial/repair/fallback all count against the shared provider-request budget.
